pages.text: $(bold)Cold-Blooded$() (default trait of Formless Ice, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)Every attack - $(bold)melee, ranged or spell$() - appends a burst of $(bold)Ice-school spell damage$() $(bold)after$() the hit resolves, equal to $(bold)0.1 x (1 + level)$() of the damage dealt.$(br2)Level 1 is 20%, level 3 is 40%. The burst is attributed to the player, so rules like the Life Lamp Ring's mercy and true piercing apply to it as usual.
